name: Common Cold
riskFactors: Age (children under 6 are at greatest risk)
homeCare: Soothe your throat with warm salt water gargle
prevention: Stay away from people who are sick
recommendedTests: No specific test needed. Diagnosis is based on symptoms.
redFlags: Fever lasting five days or more
Severe sore throat, headache or sinus pain
complications: Other secondary infections like strep throat or pneumonia
